directive: Build attachment to a main deity, then create desire for specialists and faction exploration without mandatory deity locks.

startingFactionDecision.name: Aten Ra
startingFactionDecision.reason: Existing campaign architecture currentImplemented points to Aten Ra; realm codex frames Gate law, judgment, and the first one-deity crossing cleanly. This preserves canon and avoids inventing a starter faction.

firstDeityChoice.mode: small canon-safe starter choice if product wants choice; otherwise default to Aten-Ra

defaultDeity.name: Aten-Ra
defaultDeity.reason: Durable, readable, objective-safe, and thematically tied to Gates, law, and survival.

optionalStarterSet.name: Aten-Ra
optionalStarterSet.why: long survival, objective holding, hazard endurance

optionalStarterSet.name: Iset Obsidian Dawn
optionalStarterSet.why: fast enemies, terrain-heavy battles, caster denial

optionalStarterSet.name: Amunet Prism Verdict
optionalStarterSet.why: heavily armored enemies, shield windows, boss armor phases

firstDeityChoice.guardrail: Do not show the full roster at onboarding.

firstMissions.lesson: Awaken first deity; movement and basic attacks
firstMissions.missionBeat: The Gate opens; the deity crosses alone.
Enemies force use of range, facing, and safe lanes.
First telegraphed attack creates a dodge/parry/counter prompt.
Judgment rays, ruins, or river-light lanes reward terrain mastery.
Elite teaches priority target and stance discipline.
Choose an ability evolution or stance upgrade, not a flat stat.
Multi-phase Gate enemy with reaction opportunities and a weakness window.
Second deity appears through story/battlefield event, solves a problem differently.
Player temporarily pilots the second deity with its mechanic, gear sample, and Divine Ascension.
Unlock through progression/trial/personal quest path, not pure sales pressure.
A Gate incident reveals another canon faction as a new world.
Temporary mission teaches faction environment, combat philosophy, Codex, and deity identity.

secondDeityRecommendation.principle: Pick a radically different playstyle from the starter.

candidates.name: Sutekh
candidates.why: enemy casters, elite mechanics, Momentum/Divinity denial

candidates.name: Karnu Glass Horizon
candidates.why: large enemy groups, ranged pressure, objective zones

candidates.name: Amunet
candidates.why: execution-based encounters, priority targets, mobility assassinations

secondDeityRecommendation.unlockMethod: story encounter -> playable trial -> personal quest/shard completion -> permanent unlock

deityTrialSystem.ownershipConversion: After trial, show what mastery, gear, personal quest, and faction progression would unlock.

factionTrialSystem.purpose: Make every faction feel like another world and combat philosophy.

freePlayerPolicy: Deity acquisition must include campaign rewards, trials, personal quests, faction progression, shards, events, bosses, raids, achievements, and Codex discoveries. Premium may accelerate only if existing monetization permits; it must not be required.
